=== Lead photograph (30 Oct 2026) ===
The lead is a crop of the man on the far right in a Facebook photograph posted 24 February 2022. Exact legal name already on the wiki plus membership in the Star Wars CCG Facebook group (facebook.com/levon.knowles). The uncropped original is a family photograph at Disney's Animal Kingdom; a comment calls it a beautiful family. Lives Pawling, New York; Brewster is nearby. Wiki File is the dest JPEG of the photograph. The File page Preserved copy is the Facebook photo-viewer screenshot. Identification stays on Talk. See [[:File:Levon Knowles portrait.jpg]] and [[:File:Levon Knowles Facebook portrait.jpg]].
